newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB cuts variable home rate to 6.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB cuts variable home rate to 6.7 pct.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Wednesday it has cut its variable home loan interest rate to 6.7 percent from 7.2 percent following the reduction in the official cash rate.
The new rate, available to both owner occupiers and investors, would take effect from August 4 for new borrowers and September 29 for existing customers, NAB said.
Australia's central bank earlier on Wednesday eased monetary policy with a 0.5 percentage point cut in official rates to 5.0 percent.

Rival bank, Commonwealth Bank of Australia has cut its standard variable mortgage rate to 6.8 percent from 7.2 percent, while Westpac Banking Corp cut its 'no-frills' First Option home loan by 0.5 percentage points to 6.19 percent.
The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd has said it is reviewing its rates.
